652:t_1:88.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...I've heard about $$キタン$$ too...」

652:t_1:89.en:
$$クロウ$$
「And you won't forget Major $$グラハム$$ either...」

652:t_1:91.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$n... Don't get any strange ideas.」

652:t_1:93.en:
$$クロウ$$
「There comes a time for everyone when they have to do that...」

652:t_1:94.en:
$$クロウ$$
「But don't give up looking for another way until the very end.」

652:t_1:96.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I thought you might be feeling trapped over what happened with $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ and $$ティティ$$...」

652:t_1:97.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Anyway, I don't want to see a comrade die either... especially someone younger than me.」

652:t_1:100.en:
$$葵$$
「Still, it's depressing... The $$バアル$$'s nests are crawling with things like those...」

652:t_1:101.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「The galactic center, where the $$宇宙怪獣$$ nest, and the dimensional rift we saw when we were transferred before, which seems to be the $$インベーダー#robot$$'s base...」

652:t_1:102.en:
$$朔哉$$
「But the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ couldn't find the dimensional rift in their survey, right?」

652:t_1:103.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Right... Apparently it neither exists at all times nor occurs only in a particular location.」

652:t_1:104.en:
$$くらら$$
「That's why we're heading for the galactic center first.」

652:t_1:105.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「But when I think about another space monster like that fluctuating gravity source appearing...」

652:t_1:106.en:
$$カズミ$$
「We believe that type evolved by somehow incorporating gravitational collapse into its body.」

652:t_1:107.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Dr. $$トライア$$'s system transfers the surrounding area into another dimension, so we can handle the gravitational collapse when we destroy one, but...」

652:t_1:108.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「I'd rather not fight anything like that if we can help it.」

652:t_1:109.en:
$$朔哉$$
「I wish we could connect with them like we did with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$.」

652:t_1:111.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「If we could do that, we wouldn't have any trouble.」

652:t_1:112.en:
$$朔哉$$
「W-what?! We can be friends with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ and the $$バジュラ$$! I just thought maybe we could with them too!」

652:t_1:113.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「In the first place... They're called $$バアル$$, humanity's natural enemies, because we can't communicate with them, right?」

652:t_1:114.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「If we could, I suppose they wouldn't be $$バアル$$ anymore.」

652:t_1:115.en:
$$ノノ$$
「About that... There's something $$ノノ$$ has been wondering for a long time.」

652:t_1:117.en:
$$マリ$$
「Is it the $$インベーダー#robot$$ this time? Or $$ミケーネ$$? The army of darkness?」

652:t_1:118.en:
$$チコ$$
「The universe is so huge, yet it's full of enemies...! I can't stand this!」

652:t_1:119.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Save the complaints for later. Let's go, everyone.」

652:t_1:120.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes! With hard work and guts, I'll protect the universe's future!」

652:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Their souls live on within bodies of steel... That is eternity born from the fusion of spirit and matter...」

652:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Hero $$ガラダブラ$$... Your battle over the title of hero, and your soul-stirring battle with $$ゼウス$$...」

652:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「We shall put the 100 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s they produced toward our strength...」

652:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This is hardly the time for such talk, but $$Ｄトレーダー$$ is open for business!」

652:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Our celebrations for ace pilots will have to wait until next time, but today, I'll keep giving it my all... Business, business!」

652:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This is hardly the time for such talk, but for now, we're open for business!」

652:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Our celebrations for ace pilots will have to wait until next time, but today, I'll keep giving it my all... Business, business!」

653:t_000:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Now then, who's our opponent today?!」

653:t_000:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Whoever it is, I ain't backing down!」

653:t_000:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Damn right! None of these bastards are anyone I need to hold back against!」

653:t_000:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Given the situation, I'd rather avoid fighting as much as possible.」

653:t_000:5.en:
$$刹那$$
「But there are some opponents we cannot avoid fighting, even if we can exchange thoughts...」

653:t_000:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「You mean beings we cannot coexist with...」

653:t_000:7.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「It seems some of those very beings have arrived.」

653:t_001:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「Damn $$ミケーネ$$! You never learn!」

653:t_001:1.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「You have come far, Earthlings! But your fate ends here!」

653:t_001:3.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「He's the hero returned from hell...! I didn't expect him to come!」

653:t_001:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「Looks like $$ミケーネ$$ is starting to feel the heat too!」

653:t_001:5.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「I, $$ガラダブラ$$, have come on Lord $$ハーデス$$' orders to settle things with you!」

653:t_001:6.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Earthlings! I no longer consider you weak and immature! I shall face you with all my might!」

653:t_001:7.en:
$$勝平$$
「Now that's something I'm happy to hear!」

653:t_001:8.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You finally truly recognize our strength!」

653:t_001:9.en:
$$万丈$$
「We must be careful. With neither carelessness nor arrogance in him, we shouldn't treat him like our earlier enemies.」

653:t_001:10.en:
$$葵$$
「But unless we get past him, we can't fight the boss waiting beyond him!」

653:t_001:11.en:
$$甲児$$
「Let's settle this, $$ガラダブラ$$! I'll end our feud right here!」

653:t_003:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「So you've come, $$インベーダー#robot$$!」

653:t_003:1.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Grrr, damn $$バアル$$! Do you intend to interfere with this battle and devour both us and the Earthlings?!」

653:t_003:5.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「What is it, little girl?!」

653:t_003:6.en:
$$ノノ$$
「The $$インベーダー#robot$$... aren't really $$バアル$$, are they?」

653:t_003:7.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「The $$インベーダー#robot$$... aren't really $$バアル$$, are they?」

653:t_003:8.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「The $$インベーダー#robot$$... aren't really $$バアル$$, are they?」

653:t_003:9.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Of all the things you could say...!」

653:t_003:10.en:
$$ノノ$$
「After all, we can talk with those people called $$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$...」

653:t_003:11.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「After all, we can talk with those people called $$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$...」
